data.name: Ubaniel
data.gender_notes: Ubaniel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ubaniel is a Hebrew name derived from the Hebrew words 'Elohi' (God) and 'Yibhun' (help). It means 'God is my helper'. In the Bible, this name is associated with the angel who led the Israelites to victory over the Midianites (Judges 7:9). Ubaniel is also mentioned in the Old Testament as a descendant of Judah and a father of Perez (Genesis 38:27).
data.spiritual_meaning: Ubaniel is a name that embodies faith and trust in God's help and guidance.
data.etymology: Ubaniel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is my helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ubaniel total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_greek.name: Ουβανιήλ
in_greek.meaning: Ουβανιήλ - ο Θεός είναι ο δοκιμαστής μου

Overall, Ubaniel serves as a reminder of the power of faith and God's helping hand in our lives.
